description:
FALAK SOLO 

We are a passionate team of developers and Management Information Systems students based in Cairo. We specialize in building full-stack web platforms and data management systems.

Our focus for the hackathon is to work collaboratively to design and build a complete, end-to-end platform using NASA open-source data (Website + Admin Dashboard).

We are fully structured with all necessary technical roles and ready to collaborate effectively.

First time at NASA Space Apps Challenge!
